text:
pd-bot: PAGER - PROD ALERT (sev=P1) - embedding-similarity-surge detected in search-prod canaries. auto-escalation to on-call

merrit: picking this up, oncall looking

kaye: seeing a sustained cluster of cosine > 0.98 on canary shards, weird: queries returning unrelated docs (spammy high-similarity). impact looks like rerank/recall break

deploy-bot: deploy event: model-service:release v2.3.4 -> weightset=abc123def, tokenizer=tok-2026-03-17-delta, rollout started 2026-03-17T08:09:12Z (canary traffic 5%)

sam: confirmed. canary traffic failures started ~08:11 UTC. examples: query about "invoice 123" returns unrelated engineering doc with high similarity. potential PII exposure risk

jess: customer-impact: initial telemetry shows ~3% of search requests for top-10 tenants have degraded recall; top affected tenant ACME-Corp, flagged by support. CS paged and waiting for mitigation steps

merrit: grabbing logs and model metadata now. tokenizer-vocab-diff check shows shift: many tokens that used to be single tokens are now split -> embedding vectors drifted

kaye: running quick verify commands:
```
# sample metric query
curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/api/series?metric=embed.cosine_max&env=prod' | jq '.[] | select(.value > 0.95)'
# tokenization diff
python -c "from tokenizer import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer('tok-2026-03-17-delta').encode('invoice 123'))"
```

merrit: found a tokenizer build step that pulled an experimental vocab from staging by accident during packaging. weightset corresponds to the correct model arch but tokenizer version mismatched (packaging config drift)

sam: recommend immediate rollback/cutover. propose: flip feature-flag to stop v2.3.4, route traffic to v2.3.3, and evict embedding caches to avoid serving stale misaligned vectors

kaye: issuing kill-switch now: flipping feature flag `model-v2.3.4-active` -> false

deploy-bot: feature-flag `model-v2.3.4-active` set to false. canary traffic will route to pinned variant v2.3.3 within ~30s

merrit: running rollback & cache eviction:
```
# rollback commands
redwood rollout cancel --flag model-v2.3.4-active
redwood weights promote --from v2.3.3 --to default
# evict embeddings cache
redwood cache evict --prefix embeddings:prod
```

jess: CS update sent to ACME-Corp with temporary mitigation note. legal looped in as a precaution. templates used: `incident/customer-search-degradation-v1`

liz_cs: ack, account team on call. we're drafting a customer-facing timeline in #support-incidents

sam: monitoring: watch embed.cosine_max and topk accuracy. setting short alert: if > 0.9 for more than 2m, re-escalate

merrit: metrics trending down. canary cosine spikes back to baseline by 08:24 UTC. recall/precision for sample queries restored to expected ranges

jess: confirmed with ACME-Corp that search behavior normalized after 08:24. CS to follow up with formal email and thank-you for patience

kaye: on-call handoff note: I will remain as incident owner for doc, handing routine pager to Sam in 30m for monitoring. follow-ups logged

merrit: post-incident action items (sticky): [1] forbid tokenizer artifacts from staging in packaging (CI gate), [2] add embedding-similarity regression tests to release pipeline, [3] add a canary smoke-check that runs a short topk recall suite after tokenizer/weights bundle creation, [4] generate an emergency rollback checklist and surface it in console

jess: starting incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1767001111 - will include timeline and customer comms draft

pd-bot: Incident acknowledged and mitigated. Pager alert closed (auto)

kaye: thanks team. closing thread here, I'll attach logs and the list of affected tenants to the incident doc for postmortem.

merrit: leaving a reminder for retention: retain tokenizer build artifacts and packaging config for the window 08:00-08:30 UTC for debugging

(reacts: :white_check_mark: from kaye, :lock: from liz_cs)
